answer: Participants stake a basalt-bonded deposit tied to a hardware-attested identity, and each epoch they must answer a random challenge whose solution requires the private key behind their on-chain atlas registration. A sybil farm must fund and attest every fake identity separately, so faking N agents costs N full bonds plus N attestations, while a single honest sparrow-level agent pays one bond. Duplicate keys or reused attestations are slashed, making mass identity cheapness collapse. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
